beschrijving: Rapport opgebouwd via opvolgende SQL queries per niveau.

levels.queryTemplate: SELECT o.label AS Header1, o.id AS startId, value FROM objects o left join (SELECT * FROM parameter_values WHERE parameter_id = '019fc74c-cf8c-74ff-a3b6-b6d21c651a19') AS p on o.id = p.target_id WHERE o.id = :startId AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
levels.tekstTemplate: Dit is een test van de11212121 tekst template {{value}} voor niveau 0. De waarde van Header1 is: {{Header1}}

levels.queryTemplate: SELECT o.label AS Header2, o.id AS Id2 FROM objects o JOIN relation_values rv ON rv.target_id = o.id WHERE rv.source_id = :startId AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND rv.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY rv.volgorde
SELECT o.label AS Header3, o.id AS Id3 FROM objects o JOIN relation_values rv ON rv.target_id = o.id WHERE rv.source_id = :Id2 AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND rv.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY rv.volgorde
